occlusion: fixed nested visible-ID sets, permanent after the event, fixed original single-edge weight
prediction: none; missing edges contribute zero; no hold and no normalization
input_definition: paper v7 eq:chosen_empirical_formula: q*(delta)=1; S_i*=A_i=sum_j w_ij; S0=mean_i S_i*(event before first update)
reference_axis: initial heading, fixed throughout; retained for Vx/Vy diagnostics
primary_outcome: mean_t min(GO(t), LO(t)) over post steps 5001..6000
LO_neighborhood: self plus five nearest agents under periodic distance, total six, recomputed each step
secondary_outcomes: fraction of terminal times with GO>=0.9 and LO>=0.9

rng.initial: MATLAB twister, seed; legacy per-agent draw order
rng.mask: independent mt19937ar stream seed+100000; nested deletion order shared across profiles

statistics.unit: seed, all remaining-count conditions resampled together
statistics.trend: raw condition means; no forced monotonic fit; no prespecified universal input threshold

default_action: plan; execute requires an explicit execute action and a fresh run_id
evidence: prospectively specified simulation design; metrics-only software checks; model experiment not executed
